title: Quasi-isomorphism of the pushed resolution augmentation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], i:X.Opens -> X.Etale a continuous functor whose underlying scheme functor is open restriction [def-sc-zariski-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Use abelian sheaves with the coefficient universe of X, assume sheafification on both sites and HasExt in an arbitrary common Ext universe, and assume abelian sheafPullback i additive. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Suppose for q>0 the zero endomorphism of U -> H^q(i(U),F) is locally injective [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective]. Then for every injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], the fixed augmentation single(i_*F) -> i_*I, obtained from the inverse single-complex functor comparison followed by i_*(I.ι), is a quasi-isomorphism. The assertion constructs no replacement complex and makes no choice of a comparison map.

source.place: Tags 072W and 0733(1), direct injective-resolution proof; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 09AX; sites.tex Tags 00X5 and 00X6; extension by zero as in sites-modules.tex Tag 03DJ.

proof.text: Fix I and write the displayed augmentation as e ≫ f, with e the inverse single-complex functor comparison and f the mapped resolution augmentation. Use quasiIso_iff and split the degree into zero and n+1.

In degree zero the incoming differential is zero in both complexes. Continuous direct image is right adjoint and preserves kernels, hence preserves left homology of these two short complexes (Functor.preservesLeftHomology_of_zero_f). The resolution augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism, so ShortComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesLeftHomology gives QuasiIsoAt f 0. The comparison e is an isomorphism, and their composite is therefore also a quasi-isomorphism at zero.

In degree n+1 the single complex is exact by CochainComplex.exactAt_succ_single_obj, and the pushed resolution has zero homology by pushed_resolution_positive_homology_isZero. Apply quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt and exactAt_iff_isZero_homology. Thus the specified augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism in every degree.

proof_origin.note: H3 proves degree zero by preservation of left homology when the incoming differential is zero; positive homology is proved separately from the existing object-cohomology comparison. No new sorry is added.

theorem zariski_etale_pushed_resolution_quasi_iso
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hvan : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
        (0 : i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q ⟶
          i.op ⋙ Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q)) :
    ∀ (I : InjectiveResolution F),
      QuasiIso
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
          (i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0).inv.app F ≫
          ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map I.ι)
